params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.outcome_notes
params.description: Required. User entered or selected outcome reason. The API does an exact match on the [Application.outcome_notes][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Application.outcome_notes] in profiles.

params.name: data.negated
params.description: If true, The API excludes all candidates with any [Application.outcome_notes][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Application.outcome_notes] matching the outcome reason specified in the filter.
